subtitle: Internal Audit — Process Control Review | Scope, Methodology, Key Findings, Root Causes, Management Responses & Recommended Corrective Actions

document_brief.narrative_theme: This internal audit report assesses the Procure-to-Pay (P2P) controls at Northwind Components to explain why invoice exceptions and late payments increased and to define corrective actions that restore timely, compliant vendor payments.

structure.caption: Table 2: Root cause mapping for P2P control failures (people, process, technology)
cells: Technology: ERP tolerance set to 15% allowing auto-release
Reduce tolerance to 5%, require secondary approval for variances >$10,000, and implement monthly tolerance monitoring report.
Finding F-02 (PO not referenced on invoice)
Process: receiving not completed within 48 hours
Mandate goods receipt within 24 hours, configure system block for invoices without PO reference, and provide refresher training to receiving staff.
Reassign approval authority to two additional managers, implement SLA of 2 business days, and deploy dashboard tracking pending requests.
Technology: rule excludes credits and split invoices
Enhance duplicate detection rule set to include credit notes and split invoices; perform retrospective duplicate scan for prior 12 months.
Finding F-05 (inactive vendor accounts not reviewed)
Process: no periodic vendor master review control defined
Establish quarterly vendor master review, automate inactivity report, and deactivate vendors exceeding 12 months inactivity without justification.
